method: Offline exact (case_id, turn) union; SHA256 of original UTF-8 user text without normalization. Only recorded 202 intakes accepted. Carried records and pre-POST admission stops excluded from additional counts.

deduplication.outside_union_retained: Earlier R12 Z.ai47 072/T1 timeout remains separate history. Its different-source/model attempt is not added a second time to this unique-input union or the R17 72-HTTP ledger.

limitations: Accepted/completed describes technical execution, not correctness of model interpretation or a semantic PASS.
Five old inputs remain queued under the user pause in the historical baseline; they are not claimed executed.
The 80-case union spans historical a36 and R17 plus different models. It is not a complete uniform fresh run on R19.
Historical baseline model/tool event counters are not equated with actual HTTP totals or added to the independently guarded R17 HTTP ledgers.
Recorded zero pending/quotes/orders applies to the new R17 nine-session database at terminal, not to all historical databases.
This audit does not replay failures, query DB/runtime, modify source artifacts, or close behavioral findings.
